note: Preliminary results as the San Francisco Department of Elections publishes them by precinct in its Statement of the Vote, until the Department certifies them (certified then reads true). Precinct keys are the Election Precinct layer's prec_2022; a mail-ballot precinct ("MB") is its number. Ranked-choice contests count first choices. Write-in votes are left out, as the Department's own totals leave them out. Turnout is [registered voters, voters cast]. Each precinct's counts are in a part file named for its first two digits (p + the digits). The layout is scripts/election_results_common.py's.
